capabilities: Create agenda item notes with type, audiences and pending properties
Insert agenda blocks listing what is pending for a person, meeting or all audiences
Tick off each audience separately with an optional one-line outcome in the item's Log
Edit the audiences of the open agenda item
Show done items from the last 30 days with their outcomes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; audiences are ordinary notes with type: person or type: meeting (active: false hides one), so no data is stored in settings. Install is from source build or GitHub releases via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track meeting agenda items per person or meeting and tick each audience off separately with a recorded outcome.

relations.evidence: The options work as in Open Threads' threads block

summary: Agenda manager that makes one note per topic and tracks what is still pending to raise with each person or meeting, ticked off one audience at a time.
